patch.value: Distinguish Vitest coverage-threshold exits from test assertion failures in combined runner verdicts

A focused canonical coverage invocation reports seven test files and all 199 tests passed, but Vitest exits nonzero for the unchanged global coverage thresholds. run-tests.mjs treats that exit as a test-execution failure, combines it with the exact-source coverage refusal, and prints Test execution and exact coverage both failed with exit3. Preserve fail-closed coverage while classifying assertion execution independently from Vitest threshold exit semantics.

Reproduce all-pass focused tests plus coverage-only failure; retain nonzero exact coverage admission and unchanged full denominator; distinguish test-only coverage-only and combined failures without parsing fragile human log strings
A coverage-only shortfall reports tests passed and coverage failed; actual test failures retain a distinct combined verdict.
